DEMO NASA-style requirements. All text below is invented for testing.

3 Software management
3.1 Planning
The project manager shall develop a software management plan for each software project. [SWE-901]
The project manager shall track software cost and schedule against the plan. [SWE-902]
4 Software assurance
4.1 Testing
The project manager shall perform unit testing of safety-critical software and record the results. [SWE-950]
NOTE Unit test coverage expectations are described in NASA-HDBK-2203.
